_readme: Golden vectors for the vidra internal-auth v1 HMAC protocol (X-Vidra-Internal-Auth).
Generated from vidra-search internal/api/auth.go, which is the canonical verifier.
path is the DECODED path (Go's r.URL.Path), never the percent-encoded RequestURI.
The query string and the request body are NOT signed.
This file is shared: vidra-core's signer must reproduce it byte for byte. Copy it, do not re-derive it.

vectors.name: get_search
vectors.note: The base case: hex HMAC-SHA256 over "ts\nMETHOD\nPATH".

vectors.name: get_suggestions_same_ts
vectors.note: Same secret and ts as get_search: the path is signed, so the signature must differ.

vectors.name: post_events
vectors.note: The method is signed too. The body is NOT.

vectors.name: different_secret
vectors.note: get_search under a second secret; pins that the key is the HMAC key, not a salt.

vectors.name: delete_history_entry_with_space
vectors.note: DECODED path. The signer signs, and the verifier compares, r.URL.Path — NOT RequestURI. A caller that signs the percent-encoded form (hello%20world) will 401.

vectors.name: delete_history_entry_cjk
vectors.note: DECODED path with a multi-byte segment: the signature is over the UTF-8 bytes of the decoded path, so the wire form (%E6%97%A5...) never enters the HMAC.

vectors.name: epoch_zero
vectors.note: ts is formatted as a base-10 int64 with no padding; 0 is "0".
